name: market_history
description: Download bounded historical OHLCV prices and optional dividends/splits for one Yahoo Finance symbol, with a total-return summary. Use either period or start/end dates; intraday history is limited by Yahoo.

symbol.description: Yahoo Finance symbol, such as MSFT or BTC-USD.

start.description: Optional inclusive start date in YYYY-MM-DD format.

end.description: Optional exclusive end date in YYYY-MM-DD format.

adjusted.description: Adjust OHLC prices for splits and dividends.
